art_instructions: Compose a wide scene that shows the classroom interior on the left and the sunny porch and garden outside on the right through an open, Mediterranean-blue–trimmed doorway. Owl is stepping out through the doorway, centered on the right third of the image and about one-third of the image height, wings slightly spread, body angled to the right, with one talon on the wooden threshold and the other already outside. She has mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, a small green scarf at her neck, and a tiny satchel slung across her chest; her expression is cheerful and intent on leaving. Bright sunlight pours in from outside, casting a warm oval of light on the woven rug just inside the door and a soft shadow behind Owl to emphasize her outward movement. On the left interior, include two honey-colored low desks and chairs, part of a teacher’s podium, and a small wall board with large, simple α β γ and 1 2 3 in childlike strokes to match earlier learning scenes. Through the doorway, show whitewashed stucco with blue wooden trim, a single wooden porch column, a strip of terracotta roof, a stone path, an olive tree branch, bougainvillea blossoms, and a small stone bird bath. Place a wooden sign above the doorway reading ΣΧΟΛΗ in blue letters to make the location clear for children. Keep the viewpoint at a child’s eye level so both interior and exterior details are readable, with bright, friendly colors and clear separation between indoor shade and outdoor sunlight.
